research.summary: Independent garage and MOT centre with a good local reputation and strong Google reviews. They already have a website, but it's clearly several years old, doesn't work properly on a phone, and doesn't let anyone book an MOT. Most of their customers find them on Google and then land on a page that's hard to use.
observations: Website loads but isn't mobile friendly — most of their traffic will be on a phone
Phone number on the site isn't clickable
Opening hours on the website don't match the Google listing
No MOT booking or enquiry form anywhere
Google reviews are recent and positive, so people are definitely finding them
problems: People search on a phone, tap through, and have to pinch and zoom to read anything
Conflicting opening hours cost them trust and wasted journeys
No way to book or enquire outside of ringing during working hours
The site makes an established garage look less professional than it is
opportunities: Rebuild as a fast mobile-first page with a tappable phone number
Simple MOT booking / enquiry form that captures out-of-hours interest
Bring the site in line with the Google listing
Put the reviews front and centre — they're the strongest asset they have
talkingPoints: They are being found already — this is about not losing those people
Most people looking up a garage are standing next to a car on their phone
A missed evening enquiry is a missed MOT
Their reviews are better than their website suggests
notes: EXAMPLE DATASET — written to demonstrate the tool, not researched
They already paid for a site once, so expect "we've already got one"
Don't lead with the site being bad — ask whether it brings them work

script.opening: Hi, is that Dave? It's Ollie calling from NexalField. I know this is out of the blue so I'll be quick — I was looking at Westfield Autocare online, had a look at your website, and there was one thing I thought might be costing you enquiries. Have I caught you at an alright time for thirty seconds?
script.hook: I build websites for local businesses around TW9. The reason I rang you rather than anyone else is that your Google reviews are genuinely good, so people are finding you — but when they tap through on their phone the site's quite hard work, and there's no way to book an MOT. Can I ask you something quickly?
script.valueStatement: You've already got the bit that most garages struggle with — people are searching for you and the reviews are there. The bit that's letting you down is what happens in the next ten seconds, when they tap through on a phone and can't easily read it or book anything. That's the whole job — make that ten seconds work for you.
script.demoOffer: What I'd like to do is rebuild your homepage as an example — same business, just how it'd look on a phone with an MOT booking on it. Fifteen minutes of my time, then you can look at the two side by side. If you prefer what you've got, fair enough.
